decision: Sam, PM session on 2026-11-19: 「暫停 7 天」 to the PM's question 「是否暫停逐案測試准入 7 天，功能測試改為普通 PR 加功能 CI 加一次評審？」 (AGENTS.md, in force until the end of 2026-11-26), so these functional tests carry no per-case approval. Scope: Sam approved the AR first phase on 2026-11-19 (「批准，含作廢收款」 and 「確認」, relayed by the PM). The author (claude-erp-app-ar-01) does not approve this receipt.
purpose: AR first phase, PR 3 of 3: invoices from shipped shipments (draft, confirm, cancel, void), invoice list and detail, and the invoiced-shipments lookup. Proves on real MySQL that line amounts follow the approved remaining-pool rule in shipment order through Fulfillment's readInvoiceSourcesInTransaction, that a shipment line sits on one active invoice at a time and can be invoiced again after cancel or void, that a void needs a reason and no active allocation, that the due date follows the payment term unless changed with a reason, that dates cannot be in the future, and that invoice permissions do not inherit.
data: arInvoiceFromShipments: 2 cases, each in its own isolated database built by the existing unchanged Fulfillment fixture shipmentDraftFixture (pinned by fulfillment-task036-event-recovery-functional.json): 1 sales order with 1 line of 5 units and at most 2 shipments; at most 6 invoices and 2 receipts per case. arInvoices: 3 cases on the shared AR HTTP fixture (pinned by ar-receipts-allocation-aging.json): about 15 ar_invoices rows written by SQL and 1 receipt. arInvoiceAmount: 2 unit cases with inline values.
concurrency: Serial, except two places in one case that each send 2 concurrent commands on a 2-connection pool: two drafts for the same shipment (one succeeds) and two receipts (both succeed).
thresholds: All cases pass; exact equality on amounts, statuses, versions and numbers; coverage floors unchanged; no timing threshold.
trigger: Existing ci.yml triggers and discovery only: the existing server MySQL integration shards and server test job. No new job, schedule or dispatch. No capacity or performance workload.
cost: Local run: about 2 s per isolated-database case (4 s for the file), about 1.2 s for the HTTP file, under 0.1 s for the unit file; not measured in CI. No new job.

cases: 分兩次出貨的訂單行：金額按出貨次序由剩餘池計算；同一出貨不可重複開票；取消或作廢後可重開；確認取號
到期日由付款條款現行日數計算，可改而須原因；沒有條款時必須輸入；兩個同時開同一張出貨的請求只有一個成功；權限在交易內重驗
發票確認取年度流水號；取消只限草稿；作廢須原因而且須先解除全部核銷，作廢後號碼保留並離開帳齡表
發票列表：新到舊、分頁、狀態、客戶、幣別、日期、只列未收及前綴搜尋；已開票出貨查詢及建立草稿的輸入驗證
權限：發票命令要 ar.invoice.mgmt，查看要 ar.view，兩者互不繼承，收款權限不能操作發票；未登入一律 401
each shipment takes its half-up share of what remains, and the shipment that uses up the quantity takes the remainder
the result depends only on the order line and the quantities shipped before it, and a shipment beyond the ordered quantity is refused
